name: QR code generator
description: Makes a printable QR code: a link, a Wi-Fi network or a contact, styled, and saved as a 3MF with a part per filament.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A link becomes a tile at the size it will print, with the code, the tile under it and the border each going to a filament of its own.
Dots instead of squares, and the three eyes drawn as circles. Every shape is picked from a row of pictures, and the tile redraws as you pick.
What to look at before printing: module size, quiet zone, contrast and the error correction left spare, with the code as a reader sees it.
A Wi-Fi network, in the dark theme. Each part carries its filament into the 3MF, so a slicer opens it with the colours already assigned.
